title: GrantThai field record (one authored value in project.yaml)
description: Draft. Shared shape for every authored value in project.yaml (under `fields` or `chain.<node>`). Missing input: write `value: null` with `status: NEEDS_INPUT`; the literal string "NEEDS_INPUT" as a value is read by the core exactly as value null + status NEEDS_INPUT. NEEDS_VERIFICATION is never a status: it is a marker in `markers`, and a literal "NEEDS_VERIFICATION" value is read as value null + that marker. Markers are never dropped by any tool (spec/output/nriis-submission.contract.md).

field_id.description: <NS>.<GROUP>[.<SUB>].<NAME>. Fields listed in registry/fields.jsonl use their registry id; chain content without a registry field uses CORE.<NODE>.<NAME> (e.g. CORE.EVIDENCE.E1). IDs are never reused; renames go through registry/aliases.yaml.

status.description: See spec/common/status.yaml and spec/common/status_permissions.yaml for who may set which status.

hold_reason.description: Plain-language reason, required when markers contains HOLD_FOR_VERIFICATION.
